description: GTFS Navettes estivales de la station des 2 Alpes is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Jacques Altobelli. Ce GTFS contient les données des navettes estivales de la station des 2 alpes (Dept 38) Navette les 2 Alpes Station (bus 1 et 2) Ligne 7 Mont de Lans - Les 2 Alpes Ligne 8 Bourg d'Oisans Venosc Ces navettes circulent du 4 juillet au 31 août 2026. Coverage: Jacques Altobelli. The publisher named on the listing is Jacques Altobelli. Its keywords include bourg-doisans, navette-estivale, 2-alpes, isere, venosc. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-06-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
